order_book: Our unexecuted order book stood at approximately INR 3,647 crore as of 30th September, 2026.
Revenue grew by 46% YoY to INR 929 crore, driven by disciplined project execution and the strength of our well-diversified order book.
On the order front, we secured fresh order inflows of INR 1,250 crore during the first half FY27.
guidance: The scheme has targeted with total project outlay of INR 1.86 lakh crore, comprising of INR 1.36 lakh crore of development of intrastate transmission systems and INR 50,000 crore of 50 GW of battery storage systems.
Under the broader Viksit Bharat vision, the National Electricity Policy 2047 has set a target of 100% undergrounding of cables in towns having a population of more than 10 lakh.
